patch_description:
This design retains the strong RY–RZ–CZ–RZ structure while making a low-parameter, strictly more expressive extension. The commuting CZ chain is scheduled as two disjoint matchings, reducing circuit depth without changing its unitary when the new controlled rotations are zero.

Each alternating bridge CZ is immediately followed by a CRX. All three CRX gates share one parameter per block, so the total rises only from 16 to 17 parameters per block (104 parameters including readout). CRX does not commute with the phase feature map or the surrounding Z rotations, allowing graph-dependent phases to be converted into measurable populations earlier. Sharing the bridge parameter regularizes this added capacity and aggregates its gradient across the chain.
